definition: A way to estimate $\int_{a}^{b} y\,\mathrm{d}x$ by splitting the interval into $n$ strips of equal width $h = \frac{b-a}{n}$ and treating each strip as a trapezoid, giving $\frac{1}{2}h\left((y_{0} + y_{n}) + 2(y_{1} + \dots + y_{n-1})\right)$; it overestimates when the curve is concave up across the whole interval and underestimates when it is concave down across the whole interval.
